brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: One Keyhole hanger (hex-acc-keyhole, accessory on base 0,0,0 slot 0) is fitted. It is the wall-hanging feature. check_build reports meshClash 'clear'. I did not verify the wall-facing orientation beyond the slot choice, and only one hanger is fitted, so the rack is supported by a single keyhole.
Two Hook plates (hex-acc-hook) on the base at slots 1 and 2. Each plate carries two hooks, so four hooks total. Hooks are for hand-tool hanging only; no load rating is claimed.

finish.summary: A single full hex base (piece 0,0,0) carries one keyhole hanger on slot 0 for wall mounting and two hook plates on slots 1 and 2 (four hooks). check_build passes with meshClash clear and only an informational open-cap note. Limitations: one hanger only, and I did not confirm which face is the wall face, so the hooks' orientation relative to the wall should be checked before use. This checks fit, not strength.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
